Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an unsupported, anachronistic claim that Theodoric was “from Germany,” conflating his Germanic ethnicity with the modern nation-state. This contradicts the sourced evidence (Britannica) indicating he was king of the Ostrogoths and ruler of the Ostrogothic Kingdom of Italy (capital Ravenna). The premature finalization with “Germany” led to the wrong answer.
